sources.title: Gamecap メタファー 支援ランク攻略チャート
sources.notes: Directly inspectable Japanese 14-Follower rank table. Supplies dates, some location and quest wording; older page occasionally calls rank 8 RANK4 and assigns Neuras relics in an order that is not mandatory. Do not treat its earliest dates as hard schedule.

sources.title: GameWith 支援者のランク上げと習得アビリティ
sources.notes: Independent directly inspected detailed Japanese Rank 1–8 progression tables and archetype quests, with day/night, travel requirements and Royal Virtue gates. Priority source for operational conditions when Set A is vague or conflicts. GameWith's dedicated snake-request page https://gamewith.jp/metaphor/468204 confirms the preceding 枯れ薬の材料を探せ prerequisite that the follower summary table omits.

sources.title: HayateButler — All Followers Guide (Steam)
sources.notes: Independently authored full English rank table, edition-compatible; confirms general rank cadence, MAG-only dialogue bonuses and out-of-order Neuras relic hand-ins. Supplemental verification, never copied into Japanese source quote fields.

sources.title: アルテマ メタファー100％攻略チャート（2024-10-29）
sources.notes: Separately authored Japanese date-specific first-run 100% schedule. Independently inspected month tables, dungeon timings, Royal Virtues, Followers, collectibles and recovery spare days. Source A schedule component; its calendar is one feasible alternative, not a fixed required order.

sources.title: ゲーマーの備忘録：全要素回収チャート（2024-10-22）
sources.notes: Independently authored Japanese first-person dated 100% chart; documents 6/2–10/26 route, social ranks, travel books, 8 debate dates, Royal Virtues, quests, fishing/cooking, NG+ exclusions. Serves as spine for day/night schedule; differs from Altema in interchangeable choices and dungeon placements. Does not alone establish mandatory dates.

sources.title: GameWith 100%日別ストーリー攻略と月別チャート
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japan-language month-by-month date charts with quest deadline and time-of-day actions. Links: 6月 /466190; 7月 /467260; 8月 /467718; 9月 /467947; 10月 /468209. Corroborating material windows and city resources; reconcile different suggested calendars.

sources.title: RPG Site — 100% Walkthrough (Josh Torres, 2024-10-11)
sources.notes: Independent, detailed complete day-by-day English route; cited for cross-check of full first-run feasible run, travel-only Followers, Gold Beetles, side quests, books, and day/night resource flow.

sources.title: PowerPyx — 100% Walkthrough (ObsiEez, updated 2024-11-21)
sources.notes: Independently authored English full completion day-by-day itinerary with every trophy, follower, book, debate, Gold Beetle, drawing, quest. Explicitly notes Closing the Book NG+-exclusive superboss; routes and dates may differ from selected JP calendar.

sources.title: ゲームエイト 黄金蟲全50カ所・期限
sources.notes: Independent Japanese complete 50-site beetle list and locations, dated opening gates and missables. Used alongside GameWith and Gamex to check beetle placements and 46-for-all-rewards threshold.

sources.title: GameWith 黄金蟲一覧と交換報酬
sources.notes: Japanese independent list with 50 beetle collection requirements. Corroborates specific placements, including one-day prologue and Eldan areas, plus rewards.

sources.title: GAMEX 黄金蟲全50地点と取り逃し期限・交換報酬
sources.notes: Original detailed Japanese location text for all 50, including deadlines: 6/5 prologue; 8/9 toothbrush turn-in; 9/24 Eldan village; cumulative 46 to exchange all rewards. Supplemental B component, verified against Game8/PowerPyx.

sources.title: GAMEX 本7冊と時限問答・看板娘と裏方
sources.notes: Original Japanese written details for seven reading books, limited Julian book (7/23–8/12), eight debate opponent appearances, Maria R2+ pre-9/26 helper achievement. Disagreement: describes all debates as night, whereas firsthand GamerB calendar marks several Brilehaven 7/23/24 debates as daytime; verify actual in-game access in final accuracy review.

sources.title: ゲーム神殿 期限付き依頼の失効と報告
sources.notes: Japanese independently written report of time-limited quest windows and reporting deadlines: 6/16 medicine, 6/19 inn task, 7/11 pigeon eggs, 8/9 toothbrush, 8/10 flower, 8/30 puppet materials. Deadline assertions are corroborated against GameWith quests and GamerB before passing.

sources.title: GameWith 全依頼一覧（報告・発生日・依頼人）
sources.notes: Independent Japanese quest names/unlock order. Useful cross-reference for dungeons and quest NPCs, including pigeon eggs starting in Martira (not Grand Trad), Basilio Vinca and Eupha Hyperic.

sources.title: GameWith クリア後NG+解説
sources.notes: Japanese independently verified New Game+ contents and Book of Apocalypse availability; distinct optional route after first ending.

sources.title: PowerPyx — 50 Gold Beetles
sources.notes: Independent English 50-site written location guide and three missable beetles; corroborates 46 total needed for all exchanges.

sources.title: PowerPyx — Redscale Dragon NG+ boss
sources.notes: Independent English NG+ only encounter guide; Storyteller mode restriction and Book of Apocalypse interaction.
